name: OpenAI API
description: OpenAI provides API access to GPT-4, GPT-4o, and other frontier AI models for text generation, reasoning, image generation, embeddings, and more. It is the most widely adopted AI API with extensive documentation, community resources, and a broad feature set.

useCases.task: Generate text using GPT-4 or GPT-4o language models
Generate embeddings for semantic search or RAG
Transcribe audio to text with Whisper

setupSteps: Go to API Keys under your account settings
Add billing information (required even for free trial)
auth.codeSnippet:
import OpenAI from 'openai';
const openai = new OpenAI({ apiKey: process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY });

pricing.freeTier: No free tier (free trial credits expire); pay per token
pricing.costPer: gpt-4o: $2.50/M input, $10.00/M output; gpt-4o-mini: $0.15/M input, $0.60/M output

rateLimits.limit: 500 RPM, 30,000 TPM for gpt-4o on Tier 1
rateLimits.notes: Rate limits scale with spend tier (Tier 1-5). Limits are per model, not account-wide. Higher tiers unlock higher throughput automatically as you spend more.
rateLimits.retryStrategy: Use exponential backoff with jitter for 429 errors; the openai SDK has built-in retry logic via maxRetries option

codeExamples.title: Chat completion with GPT-4o
codeExamples.notes: Always track token usage for cost monitoring. Use gpt-4o-mini for cost-sensitive applications — it's ~17x cheaper for most tasks.

codeExamples.title: Generate embeddings for semantic search
codeExamples.notes: text-embedding-3-small is the recommended embedding model: $0.02/M tokens and 1536 dimensions. Use for RAG, similarity search, and clustering.

gotchas: Token costs accumulate quickly with large contexts. Always set max_tokens and monitor usage. A 128k context window doesn't mean you should always use it — long prompts are expensive.
API keys are scoped to an organization. If you work with multiple projects/clients, use separate organizations or project-level API keys to isolate billing and prevent accidental cross-contamination.
Model names change and older models get deprecated. Pin to specific model versions (e.g., 'gpt-4o-2024-08-06') in production to avoid unexpected capability changes from model updates.
The free trial credits expire after a short time period. You must add billing information to continue using the API after the trial.
Streaming responses require different handling — use openai.chat.completions.stream() and handle the async iterator pattern.

reliability.uptimeGuarantee: No published SLA for standard tier; Enterprise plan offers SLA
reliability.notes: OpenAI has had occasional outages and capacity issues during high-demand periods. For production applications, implement fallback models or providers.

qualityJustification: Most capable models available, largest ecosystem, best-in-class TypeScript SDK, and the most documented AI API. Slight deductions for no free tier, occasional reliability issues, and usage-based costs that can surprise teams without monitoring.
bestFor: General-purpose LLM tasks including chat, reasoning, embeddings, and image generation with the broadest model selection
